channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11: The name now says what the place is: The City's…
item.description: The name now says what the place is: The City's draft parks agreement calls P10, P11 and P11A "Open Space Parcels", and the official parcel code is kept in the name. No source read gives the parcel a proper name of its own. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address now redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: City draft Agreement for Maintenance and Operations of Mission Bay Parks and Open Spaces, 22 Sep 2023 draft (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/21383/Item-5f-Attachment-A-Mission-Bay-Parks-Agreement-DRAFT-101923), section 5(a), page 6: "P10, P11 and P11A are Open Space Parcels that are and will remain within PW jurisdiction as public right of ways".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11: SF Recreation and Parks' April 2025 timeline says…
item.description: SF Recreation and Parks' April 2025 timeline says "P11 opens - Mission Bay Commons (2015)"; the year is the only date given. OCII's December 2019 Land Use Map labels this strip "P11". OCII's September 2023 presentation is a plan for Recreation and Parks to manage the strip and does not say whether it was built. OCII's 2019 and 2024 maps place "P11" at Mission Bay Circle. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25986/20250429-PRESENTATION-Workshop-3 ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf ; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf ; https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/r0574-23.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11: The P11 page now says its description of the strip…
item.description: The P11 page now says its description of the strip (landscaped, with a row of trees) is Pier & Point's own reading of its satellite trace, and cites a September 2023 draft Mission Bay parks maintenance agreement that groups P10, P11 and P11A as a median strip and traffic circle that stay public rights of way under Public Works. It is a draft, so it may differ from the signed text. Source: Draft Agreement for Maintenance and Operations of Mission Bay Parks and Open Spaces, 22 Sep 2023 draft (sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/21383/Item-5f-Attachment-A-Mission-Bay-Parks-Agreement-DRAFT-101923); SF Recreation and Parks, Workshop 3 presentation, p.15.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11: The P11 median strip's map shape cited no sources
item.description: The P11 median strip's map shape cited no sources. It now lists the OCII 2023 transition presentation, the OCII Dec 2019 Land Use Map, the OCII Nov 2024 CAC update and SF Rec & Park's Workshop 3 deck. The record said OCII's 2023 presentation lists 'P11/11A' as already managed by Rec & Park; the deck says Rec & Park 'will manage' them, so the wording now follows it, and the physical description is labelled as resting on Pier & Point's own tracing. The identification of the strip as P11 is unchanged but flagged: OCII's 2024 update and Rec & Park's Workshop 3 timeline ('P11 opens - Mission Bay Commons (2015)') group P11 with the Commons, so what P11 covers remains an open question. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural, and the citation to Pier & Point's own mapping notes is labelled as such. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf); OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map, 2019-12 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Att%201%20Mission%20Bay%20Land%20Use%20Map.pdf); OCII, Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update, Mission Bay CAC, 2024-11-14 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf); SF Rec & Park, Mission Bay Future Parks Workshop 3 presentation, 2025-04-29 (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25986/20250429-PRESENTATION-Workshop-3).

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11: Listed as 'P11/11A' among the parcels… (~Sep 2023)
item.description: Listed as 'P11/11A' among the parcels RPD "will manage" (not among the 'when built' parcels) in OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, with the open space to transfer "by the end of December 2023" (an expected date). This is a plan; it does not say the median was complete or when it was built (~Sep 2023). Source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org), 2023-09.
item.source: Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (sfocii.org), 2023-09

item.title: Complete · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P11: SF Recreation and Parks' Mission Bay Parks… (~2015)
item.description: SF Recreation and Parks' Mission Bay Parks Community Meeting #3 presentation (April 29, 2025), Timeline slide, lists "P11 opens - Mission Bay Commons (2015)" (an event year given in a later retrospective timeline; no month, and the slide does not describe the parcel). OCII's December 2019 Land Use Map labels the thin strip between Mission Bay Circle and P11A "P11", which is why that entry is read as this strip (~2015). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department, 2025-04-29; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2019-12.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department, 2025-04-29; Office of Community Investment and Infrastructure (OCII), 2019-12
